subject.title: feat: hide unpriced products on the public home

question: Should the generic DinkusKit store starter intentionally present Regular/Sale prices despite the current design contract excluding price implication?
rationale: The PR adds a user-visible product capability that directly conflicts with the repository's prioritized design contract, so acceptance requires explicit maintainer intent.

options.title: Preserve the current contract
options.body: Keep the unpriced-listability work only if it can remain a non-price proof, and remove public Regular/Sale presentation.

options.title: Adopt price presentation
options.body: Approve price as a starter capability and update the design contract and feature boundary before merging this UI.

recommendation.title: Preserve the current contract
recommendation.body: Keep the unpriced-listability work only if it can remain a non-price proof, and remove public Regular/Sale presentation.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the identified recent contributor for the affected feature and can provide the implementation context for the product decision.
